text: A period-doubling (flip) bifurcation, the route to chaos in the logistic map, occurs when:
choices: A pair of complex eigenvalues crosses the imaginary axis (as in a Hopf bifurcation)
A Floquet multiplier crosses +1, annihilating a pair of fixed points
A Floquet multiplier of the orbit crosses -1
The determinant of the Jacobian passes through zero
explanation: The text states a period-doubling (flip) bifurcation happens when one of the orbit's Floquet multipliers crosses -1. Crossing +1 is the saddle-node case (option 1), and a complex pair crossing the imaginary axis is a Hopf bifurcation (option 0).
